targets.review_note: Special-case relation is exactly a strictly downward all-type0 path. Part relation follows a possibly empty upward type0 path fromu to LCA(u,v), then a nonempty downward all-type1 path tov. It does not infer that a special case of a part must itself be present as a part: that inference is absent from stated rules. In the parent forest there is a unique undirected path, so these languages exactly close under given transitivity and inheritance rules. Binarylifting LCA plus monochromatic componentroot labels answer queries; disconnected/self relations false. Validate using independent fixed-point logical relation closure for random forests and all orderedpairs, not path formula.
